No, [Almedio Inc.](https://www.almedio.co.jp/en/) does not sell or distribute finished wearable medical devices.

Instead, Almedio Inc. focuses on functional and nanomaterials (such as carbon nanofibers and synthetic graphene compounds) used across various sectors including the medical industry, alongside custom hardware/device integration solutions and optical/storage device technologies. You might be thinking of a medical technology firm or a medical distributor with a similar name (such as AliMed or Alio). [](https://www.almedio.co.jp/en/enterprise-en/nanomaterial-en/)

If you meant a different company or are looking for a specific type of **wearable medical device**, please let me know the **product name** or **intended application** so I can help you find the right manufacturer or distributor.

Almedio Inc.
does not manufacture continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or remote patient monitoring systems
. The company specializes in optical media test discs, archiving storage solutions, thermal insulation materials, and industrial nanomaterials like carbon nanofibers.
